content.short: Superset is a unified execution layer for on-chain FX between stablecoins.
content.description: Superset is building an execution layer for on-chain foreign exchange. As stablecoins in different currencies become common, it aims to consolidate liquidity into a shared venue so trades execute predictably, with deeper markets and better pricing. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Superset.
content.meta: Superset is an execution layer for on-chain stablecoin FX, listed in Plasma's ecosystem directory.
